title: Completed pullback preserves shifts and distinguished triangles
statement: Let $u:T'\to T$ be a morphism of schemes. Fix the Noetherian adic datum $(A,I)$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], including finite perfect quotients $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$, and use its completed ring sheaves $A_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$ on the small pro-etale sites, for $W=T,T'$. Let $P_u=Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$ be precisely the strict-tower completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], defined on the full subcategory of derived $I$-complete objects of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. It has natural shift isomorphisms $P_u(M[r])\cong P_u(M)[r]$ for $r\in\mathbf Z$, satisfying the shift unit and composition identities. For every ambient distinguished triangle $M\to N\to Q\to M[1]$ whose three vertices are derived $I$-complete, the image triangle, with final arrow followed by this shift comparison, is distinguished in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_{T'}))$ [def-weil-triangulated-category]. This assertion concerns the specified reduction-tower, derived tower pullback and derived inverse limit construction; it assumes no constructibility or noetherianity of the schemes.

proof.text: Use the actual completed-coefficient presentation and its unit-normalized completion reflector F, supplied by the completed-pullback interface. Let P be the intrinsic complete-object predicate. First show it is invariant under isomorphism: transport the complex representative through the completed-coefficient comparison; the new completion map is the old one precomposed by an isomorphism. The reflection identifies P(X) with invertibility of the completion unit eta_X. The already specified unit-compatible integer shift structure of F gives eta_(X[n]) as the shifted eta_X conjugated by the shift comparison. Hence P is stable under every integer shift.

source.place: Tag 099N (2),(5); the existing actual completion reflection and its unit-compatible shifts in PbcCompletedPullbackActual.lean

proof.text: Prove P equals the right orthogonal of its left orthogonal, using the reflection universal property. The inclusion P <= (leftOrthogonal P).rightOrthogonal is immediate. For X in that double orthogonal, take a distinguished triangle X --eta_X--> F(X) --g--> Z --delta--> X[1]. For every complete L and f:Z->L, injectivity of precomposition with eta_X and eta_X g=0 imply g f=0. Yoneda exactness gives f=delta a for a:X[1]->L. Surjectivity of precomposition with eta_(X[1]), together with the unit shift comparison, factors a through eta_X[1]. Since delta eta_X[1]=0, f=0. Thus Z lies in leftOrthogonal P. Orthogonal triangle closure also puts Z in its right orthogonal, since X and F(X) lie there. Applying both orthogonality conditions to id_Z gives id_Z=0. The triangle criterion for a zero third vertex implies eta_X is invertible, hence P(X). Mathlib orthogonal closure, with the shift stability from Step 1, now proves P triangulated.

source.place: Orthogonal closure, Yoneda exactness and the zero-vertex triangle criterion; the double-orthogonal argument is written out completely in the private helper reflective_triangulated

proof.text: The inclusion of the full P-subcategory is triangulated. Equip its reflection left adjoint with the shift structure obtained by adjoint mates. Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint makes that left adjoint triangulated; composing with inclusion makes the ambient completion reflector triangulated. For ordinary derived pullback, use its existing derived adjunction to actual derived module direct image. The latter is literally the unbounded right derived functor of the additive actual module pushforward. Apply the source-library K-injective right-derived triangulation theorem, with its own shift structure explicitly selected. Then the adjoint-mate shift and Mathlib Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint make ordinary derived pullback triangulated.

source.place: Adjunction.isTriangulated_leftAdjoint, applied to the existing completion and derived pullback adjunctions; K-injective triangulation from WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/DerivedCategory/RightDerivedFunctor/Triangulated.lean

proof.text: By its existing definition pbcActualCompletedPull is ordinary derived pullback followed by the completion reflector. Compose the shift structures and triangulated functor instances of Step 3. Choose that composite CommShift structure as the existential witness, and use Functor.map_distinguished on the given ambient triangle. This proves the stated conclusion for complete vertices (indeed for every ambient triangle) without any extra scheme hypothesis. The functor is unchanged: the existing unit-compatible strict-tower comparison in the completed-pullback definition remains its interpretation on complete inputs. No reconstruction of the tower exactness proof is needed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q05-ad2ad70aa (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full and every cited statement: adic datum, completed pullback, intrinsic completion, def-weil-triangulated-category, lem-pur-left-derived-from-kflat-class, lem-weil-pbc-diagram-kflat-replacements, prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality, plus the main-20261015 blueprint_updates. I also read the Stacks sources 06XN, 05SE, 014V, 0941 and 099N(2),(5) at the cited places. The statement is unchanged and not weakened. It uses the completed coefficient sheaves A_W on both sides with the structure map c_u, and does not identify them with constant coefficients. Step 1: the adic-datum definition supplies both resolving-class hypotheses (K-flat resolutions exist; quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes go to tower quasi-isomorphisms), so the derived reduction R is exact. Step 2: the diagram lemma's two clauses apply with small J=N_{>=1}^op, small pro-etale sites, commutative A_T and A_{T'}, and the ring map c_u. Its objectwise quasi-isomorphisms are quasi-isomorphisms of towers because tower cohomology is levelwise. Additivity gives exactness on the homotopy category, so V=Lu*_Tow is exact, and V is literally the functor of the definition. Step 3: prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality gives Rlim triangulated with no boundedness hypothesis, and P_u=Rlim.V.R by definition. Step 4: the domain is stable under shifts and the composite shift comparison is written out explicitly; this is honestly elementary. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses, and there is no cycle. Small cases (I=A, I=0, split triangles, A=Z_l with I=(l)) are consistent. I accept the tool_uses for the three off-unit generic tools lem-pur-left-derived-from-kflat-class, lem-weil-pbc-diagram-kflat-replacements and prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality; the three definitions listed there are notions and need none. The delivery creates no new nodes. rg over dag/nodes found no duplicate: lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange is O_E-only and asserts linearity and adjunction, not triangle preservation. The parent thm-cbc-finite-extension uses exactly this conclusion. No SGA source is used. No changes.

lean.statement: theorem completedPullback_preserves_shifts_distinguished (g : X ⟶ Y) (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) : ∃ h : (pbcActualCompletedPull g d).CommShift ℤ, (fun [shift : (pbcActualCompletedPull g d).CommShift ℤ] ↦ ∀ (T : Triangle (PbcCompletedDerived Y d)), T ∈ distTriang _ → PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete Y d T.obj₁ → PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete Y d T.obj₂ → PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete Y d T.obj₃ → (pbcActualCompletedPull g d).mapTriangle.obj T ∈ distTriang _) (shift := h)
